cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for the exact rule governing technical performance requirements for specified water-heater product classes manufactured/imported into the market; this is a case candidate, not a rule that every energy or consumer-product regulation qualifies.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Energy-efficiency/consumer-product regulation rather than public works or new infrastructure procurement; the choice neither funds installation nor prohibits every gas appliance.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for this exact technical certification/testing, device classification and compliance-information regime for specified technologies. No generic disclosure, administrative-report or consumer-protection inclusion rule is adopted.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Much of the choice is compliance/reporting administration, not development or mandatory deployment of equipment; linked standards belong to separate rulemakings and product-specific duties vary.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for the exact design/performance constraints on specified refrigeration and non-display-door technologies manufactured/imported into the market, preserving the components, exclusions and different metrics/dates.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Product energy-efficiency governance rather than a public construction program; display doors/panels remain unchanged and there is no mandate to replace every existing walk-in.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for the exact commercial refrigeration technology definitions, equipment-class performance constraints and compliance calculation regime, with retained exclusions and unchanged large-capacity ranges.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Commercial product regulation rather than construction, procurement or universal technology deployment; it does not establish one uniform new standard for every refrigerator/freezer.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for this exact mandatory emissions-sensing, control-system inspection and technical compliance mechanism. Tire transport association or industrial-emissions subject matter alone would not establish eligibility.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Primarily hazardous-air-pollutant regulation of industrial production rather than transportation operation/public works. Control options/averaging differ, and no single control device is universally required.
